<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.62.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [chore] Remove deprecated st.cache API by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15787
* [chore] Deprecate savefig kwargs on st.pyplot by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16450
* [chore] Remove global-figure support in `st.pyplot` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16464
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Provide fully-typed selection state return values by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16275
* [feature] Add client-side validation to st.text_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15714
* [feature] Add public streamlit.typing namespace by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16295
* [feature] Add `wrap` parameter to button-like elements to control label wrapping by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16325
* [feature] Expose DataEditorState in streamlit.typing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16351
* Add support for `50` step font weights in theme configs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16396
* Expand chart theme config support for light/dark/sidebar by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16357
* [feature] Add email / url / phone / search types to `st.text_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16385
* Remove `BaseWeb` for `DateInput` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16460
* [feature] Add wrap control to horizontal st.container by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16484
* Remove `BaseWeb` for `DateTimeInput` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16501
* [feature] Add wrap parameter to st.checkbox and st.toggle by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16470
* [feature] Add `wrap` parameter to `st.columns` to deactivate responsiveness by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16367
* Add `TimeField` to `DateTimeInput` calendar popover by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16502
* [feature] Add in-error install-skills callout by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15693
* [feature] Add wrap parameter to st.multiselect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16509
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Preserve inline datasets for charts built via alt.Chart.from_json (#6269) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16288
* [fix] Re-derive heading anchor when heading text changes on rerun (#8793) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16286
* [fix] st.status in an outside container blanks the app by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16316
* [fix] Restore port auto-increment on Windows by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16315
* [fix] Accept same-window self-posts in host message guard by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16327
* [fix] Pin starlette below 1.4.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16342
* [fix] support format='svg' in st.pyplot (#11489) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16283
* [fix] Don't rerun nested fragments already re-rendered by a queued ancestor (#10719) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16314
* [fix] Show full popover contents in narrow / embedded viewports (#9340) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16173
* [fix] Add MD5 fallback for FIPS-limited blake2b by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16324
* [refactor] GZip middleware to remove reliance on internal Starlette API by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16344
* Fix derived `codeBackgroundColor` and `dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16401
* [fix] Make the cache_data hash sample seed configurable (#14622) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16284
* [fix] Close websocket on malformed BackMsg instead of leaking traceback by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16392
* [fix] Correct the server.enableCORS=false startup warning by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16393
* [chore] Stabilize flaky data_editor number cell perf e2e test by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16467
* [fix] Validate timelike st.slider bounds against the frontend number range (#16474) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16475
* [fix] Preserve toasts when st.rerun() follows st.toast by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16498
* [fix] Restore color picker interaction in dialogs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16541
* [fix] Restore metric sparkline after empty chart data by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16543
* [fix] `date_input` and `datetime_input` overflow styling in narrow containers & today indicator by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16565
### Other Changes
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16317
* [chore] Release v1.61.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16329
* [chore] Release v1.61.1 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16343
* Update `st.table` font sizing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16397
* [refactor] Consolidate invalid-value API exceptions to `StreamlitValueError` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16422
* [docs] Point users to streamlit.typing imports by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16471
* Update pyarrow requirement from <25,>=7.0 to >=7.0,<26 in /lib by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16529
* [chore] Replace tenacity dependency with internal retry helper by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16497
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16546
* [refactor] Use Starlette 1.5 native gzip media/range handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16462


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.61.1...1.62.0
